_meta.description: OG Image Preview Tool — Platform Specifications
notes: This file is the single source of truth for how each platform handles OG images.
Update this file (not rendering logic) when platforms change their specs.
Sources are noted per-platform; 'community' means reverse-engineered, not official docs.

behavior.cropMethod: center-crop to 1.91:1 if aspect ratio differs
behavior.fallbackWhenMissing: Shows a small generic link icon or pulls the first large image from the page
behavior.notes: Images smaller than 600×315 render as a small thumbnail to the left of the text instead of a large card.

behavior.cropMethod: center-crop to 1.91:1 for summary_large_image; 1:1 crop for summary card
behavior.fallbackWhenMissing: Falls back to og:image if twitter:image is absent. If neither exists, no image card is shown.
behavior.notes: twitter:card must be set to 'summary_large_image' for the large preview. Default 'summary' uses a small square thumbnail (144×144 min).

behavior.fallbackWhenMissing: Shows a generic grey placeholder with a small icon
behavior.notes: LinkedIn is stricter about image quality. Images below 1200px wide may appear blurry on high-DPI screens.

behavior.fallbackWhenMissing: Shows a plain link card with title and domain only
behavior.notes: Bluesky reads standard og:image tags. It re-fetches and caches images on its own CDN. Max file size is notably smaller than other platforms.

behavior.cropMethod: Preserves aspect ratio, constrains to max embed width (~400px rendered). Tall images are shown with scroll.
behavior.fallbackWhenMissing: Shows a text-only embed with site name, title, and description
behavior.notes: Discord renders a rich embed with a colored sidebar. It respects twitter:card for large vs small images. GIFs are auto-played.

behavior.cropMethod: Preserves aspect ratio within a max-width container (~550px). Adds subtle border.
behavior.fallbackWhenMissing: Shows a text-only unfurl with site name, title, description, and favicon
behavior.notes: Slack uses its own 'unfurling' service that caches aggressively. It reads og:image, twitter:image, and also looks for apple-touch-icon as a fallback favicon.

behavior.cropMethod: Center-crop to fill the message bubble width, approximately 1.91:1
behavior.fallbackWhenMissing: Shows a compact link with just the domain name and favicon
behavior.notes: iMessage link previews are generated by Apple's bot (Applebot). The preview is rendered inside the chat bubble. Very tall or very wide images get cropped significantly.

behavior.cropMethod: Center-crop to approximately 1.91:1, displayed within chat bubble width
behavior.fallbackWhenMissing: Shows a small link preview with domain and title only, no image
behavior.notes: WhatsApp caches previews per-URL for extended periods. Users may need to send a slightly modified URL to force a refresh.

behavior.fallbackWhenMissing: Shows a text-only link card with title, description, and domain
behavior.notes: Behavior may vary by Mastodon instance since each server fetches previews independently.

behavior.cropMethod: Center-crop to 1.91:1, similar to Instagram/Facebook handling
behavior.fallbackWhenMissing: Shows domain name only as a simple text link
behavior.notes: Threads is owned by Meta and shares much of Facebook's OG parsing infrastructure.

behavior.cropMethod: Preserves aspect ratio within the chat bubble width. Very tall images are truncated.
behavior.fallbackWhenMissing: Shows a text-only preview with title and description
behavior.notes: Telegram's Instant View feature can generate rich article previews beyond basic OG tags.

behavior.cropMethod: Center-crop to fill a roughly 16:9 thumbnail area in card view
behavior.fallbackWhenMissing: Shows a default grey thumbnail based on the link's domain
behavior.notes: Reddit has multiple view modes (card, classic, compact) that display thumbnails differently. Card view uses the largest preview.
